publicInitialObservation.title: The Bell Orchard
publicInitialObservation.beginning: After the rain, a river stands among the roots of an orchard. A village and the silted hollow of a drowned city share the same valley.
rules: All combinations and their causal effects are public. These are invented laws of this valley, not historical or hydrological claims.

Earth gives water a course. A precise name spoken aloud calls the river toward its listeners. A solid bank blocks that pull but cuts river contact. Living roots can hold the water gently while transforming exact voices into growing patterns.
Concept capabilities remain known and inexhaustible. No material stocks, action credits, player clock, production wait or upkeep exist.
The historical bell and its names are properties of this one world. Knowing the concept bell does not copy a past world state. Rooting or sealing that particular memory changes what it can become.
A world response happens after each combination and then rests. Flooded places do not suffer an invisible damage tick while you think.

Saving the orchard is the initial intention. The invitations arising from what you make are optional; they are not a score checklist. You may finish once the orchard is clear, and the ending records the valley you leave.

recipes.requires: No living or root-shaped anchor already fixes the river in the hollow.
recipes.effect: Open one river course. Water leaves the other courses. Flow through the hollow exposes the buried bell. A chorus can call water away from the course unless a bank prevents it.
Make every original name audible in the village. In this world water follows a precise name spoken aloud, so the river turns toward the village.

recipes.requires: An exposed or sounding name-bearing bell.
recipes.effect: Close the original names in a stone archive. They become protected and exact, but silent. This form cannot be reopened by the available processes.

recipes.requires: An exposed or sounding name-bearing bell.
recipes.effect: Translate names into a listening grove. Roots anchor the river in the hollow. Living patterns preserve relationships, but the original exact names are irreversibly changed.

recipes.requires: A public chorus and an open village bank.
recipes.effect: Raise a bank against the name-following river. The village becomes dry and can still hear exact voices, but loses contact with the river.
Grow porous arches through the bank. Gentle water reconnects the village. The roots take the precise voices into a living reed song; only fragments remain audible.

recipes.requires: A living listening grove; no village garden yet.
recipes.effect: Carry descendants of the listening grove into the village. A new garden shares living memory; this cannot restore the original exact names.
Fix its leaf patterns as a stone garden. The transformed memory becomes durable but ceases growing. Original names do not return.

combine.at: Only earth+water takes hollow, orchard or village

finish.intention: Optional short description of the world you choose to leave

events: Water withdraws from the orchard roots and enters the hollow. A copper bell rises through the silt. Under its lip are the names of the drowned city. It is not an alarm: held close, it whispers each person once.
The river's earth course now leads toward the village. Existing roots and voices still exert their own pull.
The earth course still leads water over the village doorsteps.

response: Rain has ended. The river still stands among the orchard roots. Across the water, the village windows are dark. In the hollow between them lies the drowned city, beneath a skin of silt.
Your first intention is modest: let the orchard breathe again. What you do with the valley afterward is yours to choose.

passages.text: Water withdraws from the orchard roots and enters the hollow. A copper bell rises through the silt. Under its lip are the names of the drowned city. It is not an alarm: held close, it whispers each person once.
The orchard breathes. The village doorsteps are dry. People can approach the river. A bell whispers exact names to anyone who enters the hollow.

narrativeDisclosure.interpretation: Exact passage matching establishes availability, not that it was read. A new verbatim passage can paraphrase an already known fact; it is not automatic semantic revelation. Appreciation of enactment survives prior disclosure.

attention.meaning: Action and episode counts have named units. Agent elapsed time includes deliberation and tool delays. Neither is a human fun-per-minute estimate; batching commands earns no automatic improvement.

support: The bell became available after the initial intervention.
